---
title: "Living situation"
---

```{r}
setup_path <- if (file.exists("R/setup.R")) "R/setup.R" else "../R/setup.R"
source(setup_path)
```

Who the young person lives with. Follow-up questions are limited to the people who were asked them. A blank answer on a question that the previous answer skips is counted as not asked, not as missing.

## Household

```{r}
#| results: asis
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 7
show_dist(survey, "live1", title = "Thinking about the people you live with, what best describes your situation?")
```

## Adults in the home

Asked only of young people who do not live with their parents.

```{r}
#| results: asis
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 6
show_dist(survey, "livead1", among_asked = TRUE, title = "Which adults do you live with?")
```

## Time with each parent

Asked only of young people whose parents live apart and who live with both parents.

```{r}
#| results: asis
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5.6
show_dist(survey, "livesp1", among_asked = TRUE, title = "What best describes your situation?")
```

## Mother's new partner

Asked when the young person lives only with their mother, or lives with both parents who live apart.

```{r}
#| results: asis
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 3.8
show_dist(survey, "momprt1", among_asked = TRUE, title = "Does your mother have a new partner?")
```

## Father's new partner

Asked when the young person lives only with their father, or lives with both parents who live apart.

```{r}
#| results: asis
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 3.8
show_dist(survey, "dadprt1", among_asked = TRUE, title = "Does your father have a new partner?")
```

## Siblings in the home

```{r}
#| results: asis
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 4
show_dist(survey, "sibs1", title = "How many siblings, half-siblings, or step-siblings do you live with?")
```
